units.source_text: 同一段時間，我從銀座一家大型咖啡酒吧的女服務員那裡，得到了意想不到的關照。

en.t: Around that same time, I received unexpected kindness from a waitress at a large cafe bar in Ginza.

units.source_text: 儘管只是一面之交，但囿於那種關照，我還是感到了一種被束縛得無法動彈的憂慮和恐懼。

en.t: Although I had met her only once, that kindness held me fast, and I felt a kind of anxiety and fear that left me unable to move.

units.source_text: 那時候我已無需依賴堀木的嚮導，能一個人坐電車，能一個人去歌舞伎劇場，

en.t: By then, I no longer had to rely on Horiki to guide me; I could ride the train by myself and go to the Kabuki theater alone,

units.source_text: 還能一個人穿著碎花和服光顧咖啡酒吧，多少已能擺出一副厚臉皮的模樣。

en.t: and I could even visit cafe bars by myself wearing a patterned kimono, having learned to put on a somewhat brazen air.

units.source_text: 在內心深處，我完全沒變，依舊對人類的自信和暴力感到疑惑、恐懼與煩惱，

en.t: Deep down, I had not changed at all; I was still troubled, frightened, and puzzled by human confidence and violence,

units.source_text: 但至少表面上可以與他人一本正經地打招呼了。

en.t: but at least on the surface I had become able to exchange proper, serious greetings with other people.
